subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should this grouped Swift dependency update be accepted after its current-head macOS Swift validation is made green, or should the failing native job block the update?
rationale: The patch only changes lockfile pins, but the unresolved native failure cannot be safely attributed or waived from source inspection alone.

options.title: Require fresh macOS validation
options.body: Rebase the PR and require a successful native package resolve/build on its exact head before merging.

options.title: Accept an explicit macOS-owner exception
options.body: A macOS-area owner may intentionally accept the upstream pins only after documenting why the current native failure is unrelated or non-blocking.

recommendation.title: Require fresh macOS validation
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and require a successful native package resolve/build on its exact head before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly routes review to this macOS-associated contributor, making them the strongest available owner candidate.
